title_zh: 因持续情绪低落请诊所安排专业回电

scenario.label_zh: 因持续情绪低落请求诊所回电
scenario.goal_zh: 说明近期感受与咨询顾虑并请诊所安排专业人员回电

context_zh: 虚构来电者向诊所接待员描述感受并求助。接待员不作诊断或治疗建议。
author: author-phase07-b

sentences.speaker: Morgan
sentences.text: I'd like to speak to someone about my mood. I've felt depressed for several weeks.

sentences.speaker: Receptionist
sentences.text: I can ask a clinician to call you. Is there anything you'd like me to include in the message?

sentences.speaker: Morgan
sentences.text: I haven't been sleeping well either. I wonder if I have a sleep disorder, but I don't know.

sentences.speaker: Receptionist
sentences.text: I'll record that as a concern for the clinician to discuss, not as a diagnosis.

sentences.speaker: Morgan
sentences.text: Thank you. Reading about depression online has been deeply upsetting. Some of the stories are quite depressing.

sentences.speaker: Receptionist
sentences.text: Would you like the clinician to know that you're worried about what you've read?

sentences.speaker: Morgan
sentences.text: Yes. I'm not expecting an instant cure. I just want help understanding what's happening.

sentences.speaker: Receptionist
sentences.text: I can include that. When can you answer a call?

sentences.speaker: Morgan
sentences.text: Any time after two today. I can take the call somewhere private.

sentences.speaker: Receptionist
sentences.text: I've sent the callback request with that time window. I can't promise an exact time, but the team will contact you to arrange the next step.

targets.sense_zh: 身体或精神机能的失调或疾病
抑郁症；抑郁状态这一健康问题
